plugins.prepareCmd: npm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package ${nextRelease.version} --no-git-tag-version -o sonar-agent-${nextRelease.version}.vsix
plugins.publishCmd: npx @vscode/vsce publish --packagePath sonar-agent-${nextRelease.version}.vsix --skip-duplicate && (test -z "$OVSX_PAT" || npx ovsx publish sonar-agent-${nextRelease.version}.vsix -p "$OVSX_PAT" --skip-duplicate)
